title: Bow tie with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe27a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb84d'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- left wing of bow tie -->
  <polygon points='48,50 12,33 12,67' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <polygon points='46,50 18,37 18,63' fill='#ff87a8'/>
  <!-- right wing of bow tie -->
  <polygon points='52,50 88,33 88,67' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <polygon points='54,50 82,37 82,63' fill='#ff87a8'/>
  <!-- center knot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#ff2d6f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ff6f9c'/>
  <!-- smiling face on knot -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='47' r='1.6' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='47' r='1.6' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <path d='M45,52 Q50,57 55,52' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
</svg>
